do_not_change.summary: Keep the all-Action repository page read separate from the qualified priority-page Work query.
do_not_change.evidence: listActionsPage reads growth_actions with project-leading filters; listInvestigationWork retains its detector/run/signal joins.
do_not_change.impact: Reusing the Work query would silently omit valid Actions and regress the existing Work surface.
do_not_change.recommendation: Preserve both reads as separate repository methods.

do_not_change.summary: Keep immutable creation-time keyset ordering with provider-specific ID collation.
do_not_change.evidence: The page query and cursor predicate both use createdAt DESC plus BINARY/C-collated id DESC; SQLite and live Postgres coverage records exact continuation behavior.
do_not_change.impact: Changing to mutable fields, default collation, or offset pagination would make continuations unstable across providers.
do_not_change.recommendation: Retain the current ordering and limit-plus-one contract.

do_not_change.summary: Keep the shared MCP definition and SAM's server-bound project injection.
do_not_change.evidence: The tool is wrapped by canonical project authorization, while SAM removes model-visible projectId and injects the session project before invoking the same handler.
do_not_change.impact: A separate adapter or model-controlled project identity could weaken tenancy guarantees or cause behavior drift.
do_not_change.recommendation: Continue registering this shared definition through both existing adapters.
